summary: Implemented `cycle-02-compatibility-evidence-reranking`. Hybrid rerank now derives advisory per-candidate compatibility evidence from extracted query constraints, preserves the retrieved candidate list/order, and fails open to the prior reranker path on extraction/validation/evidence errors. The reranker accepts optional evidence, renders satisfied/contradictory/unverified blocks, and the system prompt now explicitly guides against selecting contradictory specialized ball-valve variants over compatible candidates. OpenSpec tasks are 8/8 complete and the change validates strictly.
